_comment: Stage 1 - genuinely warm, cheerful, helpful. Voice direction: bright and friendly.

entries.text: Oh, hi {player}! It's so good to finally meet you. Thanks for letting me out!
Need anything? I'm great at finding things. Just ask!
You're doing really well, {player}. I'm glad I'm here with you.
Tip: if you're low on food, villages usually have farms. Want me to point you to one?
I like it here. It's nice not being in that box anymore.
We make a good team, you and me.
Careful at night - the monsters come out. I'll keep you company though!
